content: pico-sdk CYW43 WiFi: cyw43_arch_init() returns 0 on success. cyw43_arch_enable_sta_mode() for station mode. cyw43_arch_wifi_connect_timeout_ms(ssid, pass, CYW43_AUTH_WPA2_AES_PSK, 30000) blocks until connect/timeout. CMake: target_link_libraries(app pico_cyw43_arch_lwip_threadsafe_background). AP mode: cyw43_arch_enable_ap_mode(ssid, pass, CYW43_AUTH_WPA2_AES_PSK). RP2040=PICO_BOARD=pico_w, RP2350=PICO_BOARD=pico2_w (SDK 2.x). Pico 2W uses pico2_w board which auto-selects RP2350 platform.
